purpose: Observe local design-source signals, normalize them into an inspectable reusable Design Genome, compose design plans from explicit component semantics and tokens, apply deterministic structural gates, optionally invoke a caller-selected local Chromium-compatible headless browser to capture real screenshot/DOM bytes, accept attributed external render observations, integrate those observations without promoting them to objective truth, and derive bounded repair direction from failed or held evidence.

properties.operation: one of inspect-schema, observe-project, derive-genome, validate-genome, compose-plan, judge-plan, materialize, inspect-observer, record-render-observation, judge-rendered, propose-repair, or capture-browser
properties.path: materialize target path or capture-browser evidence output directory; relative paths resolve from the machine root
properties.target: capture-browser local HTML file or directory containing index.html; URLs are rejected
properties.browser_executable: capture-browser caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable path or explicit PATH name
properties.viewport_sizes: capture-browser exact map from every design-plan viewport id to width/height and optional device_pixel_ratio
properties.timeout_seconds: capture-browser explicit bounded process timeout from 1 through 120 seconds
properties.observation: derive-genome input using axm.design-observation/v0.1, or judge-rendered input using axm.design-render-observation/v0.1
properties.genome: validate, compose, or materialize axm.design-genome/v0.1 body
properties.request: compose/materialize design request with goal, exact role/component requirements, viewports, and explicit contrast pairs
properties.plan: judge-plan, judge-rendered, or capture-browser axm.design-plan/v0.1 body
properties.observer: record-render-observation attributed observer descriptor: human, browser-tool, model, test-fixture, or other
properties.captures: record-render-observation bounded viewport captures with declared artifacts, measurements, and attributed assessments
properties.required_assessments: judge-rendered optional exact assessment ids; defaults to visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence
properties.replace: materialize only; optional explicit boolean replacement of an existing creation target

contains: bounded local source evidence without external fetching
component selector/state signals with semantic uncertainty preserved
explicit component roles and tags when actually supplied
motion grammar and reduced-motion policy state
WCAG-style deterministic contrast calculations for explicit color-token pairs
responsive, focus, reduced-motion, contrast, and coverage structural gate evidence
optional local headless browser capture materializing real screenshot and DOM bytes for every declared viewport
browser executable/version, local target digest, viewport sizes, offline host-resolution policy, artifact digests, and capture receipt
attributed external screenshot/artifact digests with explicit fetched/verified-byte status
viewport-bound measurements for overflow, focus visibility, reduced-motion behavior, rendered contrast, and interaction errors when an observer supplies them
attributed perceptual PASS/FAIL/HOLD assessments with confidence and basis
integrated render judgment bound to one exact plan digest
deterministic repair direction derived from failed or held gates without automatic source rewrite
provenance separating observed reference signals, browser execution, external observer claims, and AXM quality policy
optional validated three-file design descriptor project

relationships: upgrades Universal Creation with design knowledge instead of creating a second general creation machine
sits above Asset Atom ingredients and beside Paintgun, Vector Cell, and Chameleon visual-state machinery
keeps structure/style grammar reusable so page composition does not need to be copied
can turn a caller-authorized local Chromium-compatible executable into a real screenshot/DOM observer without adding a mandatory Python/browser dependency
lets screenshot, browser, human, image-model, or other authorized observers feed one provider-neutral evidence contract
binds every render observation to one exact design-plan digest before it can affect judgment
turns failed and held structural/render evidence into explicit repair direction while leaving actual source modification to existing creation/repair machinery
keeps design judgment inside the creation loop rather than as a final make-pretty pass

anatomy_refs.basis: Design Fabric can observe bounded local project source and materialize validated descriptors or browser evidence outside the live machine body.
The genome retains material and surface signals as structured design ingredients while keeping renderer truth separate.
Component interaction states and motion policy remain explicit design state rather than being hidden in a rendered reference.
Rendered evidence is accepted only as an attributed observation bound to exact plan and artifact digests; browser-captured bytes are marked separately from merely declared external artifacts.

implementation.source: src/axm_uc/design_fabric.py + src/axm_uc/design_observer.py + src/axm_uc/design_browser.py via src/axm_uc/__init__.py registration

limitations: local reference observation remains lexical/structural source inspection and is still distinct from rendered perception
browser capture requires a caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable and never installs or downloads a browser automatically
browser capture accepts local HTML targets only and blocks external host resolution; remote URL capture is unsupported
the v0.1 browser bridge captures real screenshot and DOM bytes but does not yet extract computed-style, accessibility-tree, interaction, or perceptual measurements
CSS selectors are component signals only and do not prove component semantics; roles must come from explicit evidence
external perceptual assessments stay attributed observations and are not promoted to objective aesthetic truth
a passing integrated judgment proves only that declared gates passed for the exact plan, observer, artifacts, measurements, and viewports supplied
visual universality, subjective beauty, originality, complete accessibility, runtime correctness, and behavior outside observed conditions remain unproven
repair plans are deterministic directions only; they do not silently rewrite source or accept their own repairs
derived genomes intentionally retain reference grammar signals without reproducing source page composition by default
persistent_state: none required; optional design descriptor projects, browser capture directories, and external observation receipts are caller-selected creation state

truth.basis: Source signals, actual browser-captured bytes, merely declared external artifacts, observer assessments, policy gates, and still-unobserved reality remain separately labeled.

agency.basis: Tokens, components, states, browser executable, viewport contract, observers, artifacts, measurements, assessments, gates, provenance, and repair directions remain inspectable and replaceable.

continuity.basis: The Design Genome and plan digests remain stable anchors while new browser and observer adapters can add evidence without replacing prior meaning.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Browser absence, missing viewport/screenshot/contrast/interaction/motion/perceptual evidence, or failed execution produces HOLD/ERROR rather than a synthetic visual-quality claim.
